findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker can inject a crafted string that, when converted to an integer, results in unexpected behavior or system calls.
findings.assumptions: The input is not sanitized before being converted to an integer. The system might allow special characters or control sequences that could be misinterpreted.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If the file content exceeds MAX_STR_LENGTH, it can overflow the buffer, leading to undefined behavior.
findings.assumptions: The file content is not checked for length before being read into the buffer.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker can influence the brightness value, which might be used in a way that leads to unexpected system calls or behavior.
findings.assumptions: The brightness value is not sanitized or validated before being written to the file.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: The new brightness value, derived from user input, is written to a file without proper validation, which could lead to unexpected behavior or system calls.
findings.assumptions: The new brightness value is not sanitized or validated before being written to the file.
